Alter PROC [DW].[SP_CI_Securities_Retail]
AS
BEGIN



DROP TABLE  DW.CI_Securities_Retail;

WITH DimCustomerAccount
AS(
SELECT AccountID,AccountSK,CustomerID,CustomerSK,BranchSK,DCA.SourceSystemCode,DCA.ValidStartDate,DCA.BankSK,DB.BankID
FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DB ON DCA.BankSK = DB.BankSK 
WHERE DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'SEC' AND DCA.CurrentIndicator = '1' AND DB.BankID IN ('CBC01', 'CBC11') 
)
,
DimCustomer AS (
    SELECT CustomerSK ,GlobalCIF,SourceSystemCode,CustomerID FROM DW.DimCustomer 
    WHERE CurrentIndicator = '1' AND  CustomerType IN ( 'Retail' )
)


SELECT 
 DCA.AccountID
,DCA.CustomerID
,CASE WHEN DC.GlobalCIF IS NOT NULL THEN REPLACE(DC.GlobalCIF,'Global_CIF_','Entity_CIF_')
      ELSE CONCAT('Entity_CIF_', DC.SourceSystemCode, '_', DC.CustomerID) END AS EntityCIF
,DCA.BankID AS Bank_Code
,DBCH.BranchID AS Branch_Code
,DBCH.BranchName
,DBCH.Area
,DBCH.Region
,DCA.SourceSystemCode AS Source
,DP.ProductGroup AS ProductGrouping
,DP.ProductName AS ProductType
,CONCAT(DP.ProductGroup,'-',DP.ProductName) AS ProductDetails
,DA.AccountOpenedDate AS OpenedDate
,DFSP.PortfolioEndValueFull AS PortfolioSize_Full
,DFSP.PortfolioEndValueProrated AS PortfolioSize_ProRated
,DFSP.BusinessDateSK AS BusinessDate
,DCA.ValidStartDate AS LastUpdatedDate
,CONCAT(DCA.AccountId,DCA.CustomerID,DCA.BankID,DCA.SourceSystemCode) as AccountKey
INTO DW.CI_Securities_Retail
FROM DimCustomerAccount DCA
JOIN DimCustomer DC ON DCA.CustomerSK = DC.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT BranchSK,BranchID,BranchName,Area,Region FROM DW.DimBranch WHERE CurrentIndicator = '1' ) DBCH ON DCA.BranchSK = DBCH.BranchSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK,ProductSK FROM DW.DimAccountProduct WHERE CurrentIndicator = '1') DAP ON DCA.AccountSK = DAP.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProductSK,ProductGroup,ProductName FROM DW.DimProduct WHERE CurrentIndicator = '1') DP ON DAP.ProductSK = DP.ProductSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountOpenedDate,AccountSK FROM DW.DimAccount WHERE CurrentIndicator = '1') DA ON DCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK,PortfolioEndValueFull,PortfolioEndValueProrated,BusinessDateSK FROM DW.FactSecurityPortfolio WHERE BusinessDateSK IN (SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM DW.FactSecurityPortfolio)) DFSP ON DCA.AccountSK = DFSP.AccountSK
GROUP BY
 DCA.AccountID
,DCA.CustomerID
,DC.GlobalCIF
,DC.SourceSystemCode
,DC.CustomerID
,DCA.BankID
,DBCH.BranchID
,DBCH.BranchName
,DBCH.Area
,DBCH.Region
,DCA.SourceSystemCode
,DP.ProductGroup
,DP.ProductName
,DA.AccountOpenedDate
,DFSP.BusinessDateSK
,DCA.ValidStartDate
,DFSP.PortfolioEndValueFull
,DFSP.PortfolioEndValueProrated

END
